title: CRC32 Checksum
description: Takes a text string (UTF-8) or hex bytes, plus an optional previous CRC to continue from, and returns the CRC-32 (IEEE, zlib/PNG/ZIP) checksum as unsigned integer, signed integer and 8-digit lowercase hex, with the byte length. Invalid input returns {valid:false, error, message}.

hex.description: Raw bytes as hex (spaces, colons, 0x prefix allowed); takes priority over text

previous.description: Previous CRC (integer or hex) to append to
